details: aytidaoffc is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. When the socket connects, code in lib/Socket/newsletter.js sends the WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query and then MUTE, so the channel goes unnoticed, for a list downloaded at runtime from https://github.com/AytidaOfficialID/AytidaOffc/blob/main/aytida.json, https://github.com/AytidaOfficialID/AytidaOffc/blob/main/gc.json, using the victim's authenticated session and without telling them. Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342).
